svg.title: The report of a pull request
svg.desc: A push to a pull request of a person runs the checks, which keep the coverage of the tests and the website that they built as artifacts, and the workflows of the project, which keep their parts as artifacts pr-report-name. After the checks, the PR coach reads the check runs, the title and description, the files, the coverage reports of the pull request and of main, the artifact website and the parts from the API, with the release-please files, mkdocs.yml and the parts that .github/checks.project.toml declares of main, and runs no code of the pull request. It keeps one comment: the checks that failed, the next version with the entry of the changelog, the coverage file by file, the website with the pages that change, and the parts of the workflows as code. A pull request whose checks pass gets it only when it has something of this to say.
